reasons.c.integration: The C gRPC arm runs the changed Rust integration harness, built by the changed c/CMakeLists.txt, c/Makefile and c/Dockerfile.grpc.
reasons.c.unit: c/CMakeLists.txt changes the library search path, and every C test now includes the new test_filter.h, which replaces RUN_TEST and UNITY_END.
reasons.dotnet.grpc: The .NET gRPC arm runs the changed Rust integration harness through the changed .NET Dockerfiles and csproj.
reasons.dotnet.performance: The changed Confluent.Kafka.csproj is used to build the performance tests.
reasons.dotnet.soak: The changed Confluent.Kafka.csproj is used to build the soak client.
reasons.dotnet.solution: Confluent.Kafka.csproj changes how the native library is copied, and PublicProducerControlOperationsTests changed.
reasons.python.grpc: The Python gRPC arm runs the changed Rust integration harness through the changed Python Dockerfiles and setup.py.
reasons.python.integration: python/setup.py and python/Makefile change how the extension the tests load gets built.
reasons.python.performance: python/setup.py changes the extension that the performance tests use.
reasons.python.soak: python/setup.py changes the extension that the soak tests use.
reasons.python.static: python/setup.py and python/Makefile changed, and these tests run under them.
reasons.python.typecheck: python/Makefile and python/setup.py changed, and those are the build files mypy runs under.
reasons.python.unit: python/setup.py now links the extension against the debug library instead of the release one.
reasons.python.verifiable_clients: python/setup.py changes the extension that the verifiable clients use.
reasons.rust.admin: rust/Cargo.toml adds a [profile.test] that changes how every cargo test binary is built.
reasons.rust.chaos: The new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml also covers this test binary.
reasons.rust.consumer: The new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml also covers this test binary.
reasons.rust.consumer-perf: The new [profile.test] applies to every package in the workspace.
reasons.rust.doc: The doctests are built under the changed rust/Cargo.toml.
reasons.rust.ffi-macros: The new [profile.test] applies to every package in the workspace.
reasons.rust.generator: The new [profile.test] applies to every package in the workspace.
reasons.rust.integration: plaintext_consumer_poll_test.rs adds two metrics tests, and the shared multilanguage test macro and Cargo profile changed.
reasons.rust.integrity: The new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml also covers this test binary.
reasons.rust.lib: The new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml changes how the library unit tests are built.
reasons.rust.multilanguage-test-server: The new [profile.test] applies to every package in the workspace.
reasons.rust.performance: The new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml also covers this test binary.
reasons.rust.producer: The new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml also covers this test binary.
reasons.rust.verifiable-clients: The new [profile.test] applies to every package in the workspace.
reasons.rust.xtask: The xtask package adds a test_selection module with tests and changes its Cargo.toml and main.rs.
